pet_notes: Original chibi humanoid memory-map companion inspired by the reference mood: sweeping golden-blond side-parted hair covering one eye, one large violet-gray eye, tailored charcoal-black formal suit with subtle teal lining, compact full-body proportions, calm observant confidence. Add one tiny integrated node-compass brooch suggesting memory mapping. No cigarette, no copied franchise symbols, no readable text, no logo.
